subtitle: A credit budget that enforces itself, no dashboard-checking required

code:
CREATE OR REPLACE RESOURCE MONITOR tb_test_rm
WITH
  CREDIT_QUOTA = 100
  FREQUENCY = monthly
  TRIGGERS
    ON 75 PERCENT DO NOTIFY
    ON 100 PERCENT DO SUSPEND
    ON 110 PERCENT DO SUSPEND_IMMEDIATE;
caption: Quota, reset frequency, and layered triggers — one statement.
From this point on, Snowflake enforces the thresholds itself.

steps.label: SUSPEND
steps.sub: Blocks new queries, lets running ones finish

steps.label: SUSPEND_IMMEDIATE
steps.sub: Blocks new queries and cancels everything now
